properties.rationale: Deliberate, not a duplicate to merge: the DUPLICATES edge between these two facts carries its own evidence, "Linked rather than merged: they were found for different reasons and both reasons matter" — the same class (a principle settled for one case and never carried to its structural sibling) found twice on unrelated surfaces. The link is the record; merging would lose one of the two reasons. Closed 2026-10-05 under dec:the-owner-delegates-the-design-cleanup-2026-10-05, pass 1 of the design cleanup.
